blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Training is how we learn new things at work. A company can offer many types of training. There are language classes, technical courses, and soft skills workshops.

The goal is simple: help people do their job better. When employees learn, the company grows with them.

Training is an investment, not a cost. A good course builds new skills and more confidence.

items.q: What is training, according to the text?
options: A way to learn new things at work
items.why: "Training is how we learn new things at work."

items.q: Which types of training does the company offer?
options: Language classes, technical courses, and soft skills workshops
items.why: O texto cita os três: language classes, technical courses e soft skills workshops.

items.q: What is the goal of training?
options: To help people do their job better
To reduce the number of employees
items.why: "The goal is simple: help people do their job better."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: training is a waste of money
spending on a good course is worth it
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "Training is an investment, not a cost" — vale a pena investir.

items.q: "The company grows with them" suggests that…
options: when people learn, the company gets better too
items.why: Inferência: aprendizado dos funcionários e crescimento da empresa andam juntos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry falar sobre o curso de inglês. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi team, this is Harry. I am organising an English course for the finance team, and I want to tell you the plan.

The course starts next Monday. We have classes two times a week, on Monday and Wednesday, from six to seven in the evening. The instructor is very good, and the classes are small.

You can join online or in the meeting room. If you cannot come one day, do not worry. You can watch the class later.

At the end, every student gets a certificate. This is an investment in you and in the team. I hope you can learn a lot and feel more confident in meetings. See you on Monday!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: When does the English course start?
items.why: "The course starts next Monday."

items.q: How many times a week are the classes?
items.why: "We have classes two times a week, on Monday and Wednesday."

items.q: What can a student do if they cannot come one day?
items.why: "If you cannot come one day… You can watch the class later."

items.q: Why does Harry say the course is "an investment in you"?
options: Because it helps you grow and feel more confident
Because it is only for the boss
items.why: Inferência: Harry liga o curso a aprender e ficar mais confiante nas reuniões.

items.q: How does Harry feel about the course?
items.why: Inferência: ele convida o time, elogia o instrutor e torce para eles aprenderem muito.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The new skill helps me write better emails." A skill is…
options: an ability to do something well
items.why: Skill = habilidade, a capacidade de fazer algo bem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At the end of the ___, every student gets a certificate."
items.why: Course = curso; é ele que termina e dá o certificado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is very good; she teaches us clearly."
items.why: Instructor = instrutor(a), a pessoa que ensina.

items.q: "Training is an investment, not a cost." An investment is…
options: money you spend to get value later
items.why: Investment = investimento: você aplica dinheiro esperando retorno.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We join a short ___ on Friday to practise soft skills."
items.why: Workshop = oficina, uma atividade prática curta.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I want to sign up for the English course." To sign up for means to…
items.why: Sign up for = inscrever-se, entrar no curso.

items.q: "The company will roll out the training next month." To roll out means to…
options: start and share it with everyone
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar para funcionar aos poucos.

items.q: "I want to brush up on my English before the meeting." To brush up on means to…
items.why: Brush up on = revisar e melhorar algo que você já sabe um pouco.

items.q: "Please keep up with the homework each week." To keep up with means to…
options: stay at the same pace, not fall behind
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar o ritmo, não ficar para trás.

items.q: "I still need to catch up on last week's class." To catch up on means to…
items.why: Catch up on = pôr em dia, fazer o que ficou atrasado.
